orig_text:
Proxy-Status: proxy.example.net; error="http_protocol_error";
              details="Malformed response header: space before colon"
correct_text:
Proxy-Status: proxy.example.net; error=http_protocol_error;
              details="Malformed response header: space before colon"
notes: The `error` parameter is defined to be a Token in Section 2.1.1. In the other examples, it is properly shown as a Token, but in Section 2.1.5's example, it is shown as a String.
